setups.label: Editorial
setups.snippet: Editorial photography style with confident magazine-page composition, purposeful negative space for text overlay, and a controlled, considered color palette that reads as intentional and art-directed.

setups.label: Documentary
setups.snippet: Documentary photography style with unobtrusive observational framing, available light, and a candid, unstaged sense of a real moment captured as it happened.

setups.label: Fashion
setups.snippet: High-fashion photography style with a strong hero pose, sculpted studio or location lighting, and a polished, glossy finish that foregrounds silhouette and garment texture.

setups.label: Street
setups.snippet: Street photography style with spontaneous, decisive-moment framing, natural urban light, and a raw, textured grain that favors authenticity over polish.

setups.label: Portrait
setups.snippet: Classic portrait photography style with a shallow depth of field isolating the subject, soft directional key light, and close attention to catchlight and skin tonality.

setups.label: Product
setups.snippet: Commercial product photography style with clean, evenly diffused lighting, crisp edge definition, and a neutral or gradient backdrop that keeps focus entirely on the object.

setups.label: Sports
setups.snippet: Sports photography style with frozen peak-action framing, a fast shutter feel, and a shallow depth of field that isolates the athlete from a blurred, motion-streaked background.

setups.label: Wildlife
setups.snippet: Wildlife photography style with a long-lens compressed perspective, patient natural-light framing, and tack-sharp focus on the animal's eye against a softly blurred habitat.

setups.label: Architectural
setups.snippet: Architectural photography style with corrected vertical lines, symmetrical framing, and a clean, graphic treatment of geometry, materials, and negative space.

setups.label: Macro
setups.snippet: Macro photography style with extreme close-up magnification, razor-thin depth of field, and fine surface texture rendered in crisp, magnified detail.

setups.label: Aerial
setups.snippet: Aerial photography style with a bird's-eye vantage, graphic top-down patterns, and a scale that transforms the landscape into abstract shape and color.

setups.label: Underwater
setups.snippet: Underwater photography style with diffused blue-green ambient light, suspended particulate haze, and soft-edged refraction that gives the frame a weightless, dreamlike quality.

setups.label: Night
setups.snippet: Night photography style with deep shadow detail, practical light sources as the primary illumination, and a moody high-contrast exposure balancing pools of light against darkness.

setups.label: Long Exposure
setups.snippet: Long-exposure photography style with streaked light trails, silky smoothed motion in water or clouds, and a static frame that renders time itself as visible movement.

setups.label: Kodak Portra 400
setups.snippet: Shot on Kodak Portra 400 with warm, naturalistic skin tones, fine grain, and gently rolled-off highlights characteristic of a classic portrait film stock.

setups.label: Kodak Portra 800
setups.snippet: Shot on Kodak Portra 800 with slightly heavier grain than its slower counterpart, rich shadow latitude, and warm color rendering suited to lower-light available-light work.

setups.label: Kodak Ektachrome
setups.snippet: Shot on Ektachrome reversal film with punchy, saturated color, cooler neutral tones, and crisp fine grain typical of a slide-film aesthetic.

setups.label: Kodak Vision3 500T
setups.snippet: Shot on a tungsten-balanced 500T cinema stock with rich shadow detail, a cool base color science, and the fine grain structure typical of a high-speed motion-picture negative.

setups.label: Kodak Vision3 250D
setups.snippet: Shot on a daylight-balanced 250D cinema stock with clean color fidelity, moderate grain, and well-controlled highlight roll-off suited to bright exterior work.

setups.label: Fuji Velvia
setups.snippet: Shot on Velvia-style reversal film with intensely saturated color, deep contrast, and vivid greens and reds characteristic of a landscape-oriented slide stock.

setups.label: Fuji Provia
setups.snippet: Shot on Provia-style reversal film with balanced, true-to-life color, moderate contrast, and fine grain suited to accurate, versatile color reproduction.

setups.label: Fuji Eterna
setups.snippet: Shot on an Eterna-style cinema stock with a soft, low-contrast tonal curve, muted color rendition, and gentle highlight handling built for subtle grading latitude.

setups.label: Ilford HP5
setups.snippet: Shot on Ilford HP5 black-and-white stock with punchy midtone contrast, pronounced but pleasing grain, and a classic photojournalistic monochrome character.

setups.label: Kodak Tri-X
setups.snippet: Shot on Tri-X black-and-white stock with deep blacks, gritty pronounced grain, and a high-contrast monochrome look associated with classic reportage.

setups.label: CineStill 800T
setups.snippet: Shot on a tungsten-balanced 800-speed stock with distinctive red halation blooming around bright practical lights, cool ambient color, and a nostalgic night-photography character.

setups.label: 16mm Grain
setups.snippet: Rendered with the coarse, organic grain structure and softer resolving power of 16mm film, giving the image a raw, textured, small-format motion-picture character.

setups.label: 35mm Grain
setups.snippet: Rendered with the balanced grain structure and resolving power of standard 35mm motion-picture film, the workhorse texture of mainstream theatrical cinematography.

setups.label: 65mm Grain
setups.snippet: Rendered with the ultra-fine grain and exceptional resolving power of large-format 65mm film, delivering immersive detail and sweeping large-frame clarity.

setups.label: Bleach Bypass
setups.snippet: Processed with a bleach-bypass look that retains silver in the print for desaturated color, boosted contrast, and a gritty, metallic sheen across the image.

setups.label: Cross-Process
setups.snippet: Processed with a cross-processed look yielding shifted, unpredictable color casts, boosted contrast, and a hyper-saturated, slightly unstable palette.

setups.label: Noir
setups.snippet: Classic noir look with hard venetian-blind shadow patterns, low-key single-source lighting, and deep black shadow pools that conceal as much as they reveal.

setups.label: Neo-Noir
setups.snippet: Neo-noir look with saturated color shadows in cyan and magenta, rain-slicked reflective surfaces, and a moody urban-night palette layered over classic hard-shadow staging.

setups.label: Western
setups.snippet: Western genre look with wide dusty-horizon framing, harsh unforgiving sunlight, and a warm, sun-bleached palette of ochre, rust, and faded denim blue.

setups.label: Epic
setups.snippet: Epic genre look with vast wide-scale framing, sweeping scope, and a grand, saturated palette designed to dwarf the human figure against monumental landscape or architecture.

setups.label: Thriller
setups.snippet: Thriller genre look with tight, claustrophobic framing, cool desaturated tones, and hard shadow edges that build unease through restrained, controlled visual tension.

setups.label: Horror
setups.snippet: Horror genre look with underlit faces, pools of near-total darkness at the frame edges, and a sickly desaturated color cast that unsettles the eye.

setups.label: Romance
setups.snippet: Romantic genre look with soft diffused backlight, warm golden color temperature, gentle lens glow, and intimate close framing that flatters and softens.

setups.label: Sci-Fi
setups.snippet: Science-fiction genre look with cool blue-cyan color dominance, hard practical light sources embedded in the environment, and clean, geometric, high-contrast staging.

setups.label: War
setups.snippet: War genre look with desaturated muddy tones, handheld immediacy, harsh haze and smoke diffusion, and a bleached, high-contrast exposure that reads as documentary urgency.

setups.label: Heist
setups.snippet: Heist genre look with sleek high-contrast lighting, cool metallic tones, confident symmetrical framing, and a polished, stylish visual control that signals precision.

setups.label: Coming-of-Age
setups.snippet: Coming-of-age genre look with warm nostalgic color grading, soft natural light, handheld intimacy, and loose, observational framing that favors emotional authenticity.

setups.label: Mockumentary
setups.snippet: Mockumentary genre look with static talking-head framing, flat naturalistic lighting, slightly imperfect handheld reframes, and a plain, unstylized visual honesty.

setups.label: Automotive Spot
setups.snippet: Automotive commercial look with sweeping low-angle tracking shots, glossy specular highlights raked across the bodywork, and a saturated, high-production color grade.

setups.label: Tech Product
setups.snippet: Tech-product commercial look with a minimalist white or dark studio void, crisp rim lighting on clean edges, and a precise, controlled, ultra-modern presentation.

setups.label: Fragrance
setups.snippet: Fragrance commercial look with soft diffused backlight, dreamy slow motion, gauzy atmospheric haze, and a sensual, romantic color palette built around skin and light.

setups.label: Sportswear
setups.snippet: Sportswear commercial look with high-energy freeze and motion-blur contrast, gritty urban texture, and a bold, saturated, high-contrast athletic color grade.

setups.label: Food Commercial
setups.snippet: Food commercial look with warm, appetizing top-light, glistening texture on glaze and steam, and a shallow depth of field that isolates the dish in tight close-up.

setups.label: Luxury Watch
setups.snippet: Luxury-watch commercial look with macro precision on dial and mechanism, hard controlled specular highlights, and a rich, dark, jewel-toned studio backdrop.

setups.label: Real Estate
setups.snippet: Real-estate commercial look with bright, evenly balanced interior exposure, corrected wide-angle lines, and an inviting, airy, naturally lit sense of space.

setups.label: Pharma Warmth
setups.snippet: Pharmaceutical commercial look with soft warm natural light, gentle handheld intimacy, and a reassuring, approachable palette of skin tones and soft neutrals.

setups.label: Energy Drink Chaos
setups.snippet: Energy-drink commercial look with whip-fast frenetic motion, oversaturated neon color, hard flash-lit highlights, and a chaotic, adrenaline-charged visual pace.

setups.label: Beauty & Cosmetics
setups.snippet: Beauty commercial look with soft flattering beauty-dish lighting, luminous skin highlights, and a clean, glowing close-up focus on texture and color.

setups.label: Financial Trust
setups.snippet: Financial-services commercial look with cool corporate blue tones, clean symmetrical framing, and a composed, confident, steady visual authority.

setups.label: Travel & Airline
setups.snippet: Travel and airline commercial look with wide aspirational landscape framing, golden natural light, and a smooth, polished sense of ease and movement.

setups.label: Foreground Anchor
setups.snippet: A strong foreground element is placed close to the lens, softly out of focus, anchoring the frame and giving the deeper scene beyond it a tangible sense of physical depth.

setups.label: Layered Midground Action
setups.snippet: A distinct midground layer of secondary action unfolds between the foreground anchor and the background, giving the frame three readable planes of depth.

setups.label: Atmospheric Depth Haze
setups.snippet: Thin atmospheric haze or dust settles over the far distance, softening contrast and desaturating color with each successive plane to sell natural depth.

setups.label: Rack-Focus Planes
setups.snippet: Multiple distinct focal planes are staged front to back so a rack focus can travel smoothly from foreground to background within a single continuous shot.

setups.label: Through-Object Framing
setups.snippet: The camera shoots through a translucent or partially obscuring object in the extreme foreground, layering texture and depth between lens and subject.

setups.label: Mirror Depth
setups.snippet: A mirror or reflective surface within the frame doubles the spatial depth, revealing a second layer of action or environment behind the camera's actual position.

setups.label: Deep Focus Staging
setups.snippet: Deep focus staging keeps foreground, midground, and background elements all sharply resolved simultaneously, inviting the eye to travel through every plane of the frame.

setups.label: Foreground Bokeh Elements
setups.snippet: Small out-of-focus points of light or texture drift across the extreme foreground, softening the frame's edge and separating the sharp subject from the lens.

setups.label: Receding Lines Depth
setups.snippet: Converging architectural or environmental lines recede toward a vanishing point, pulling the eye from foreground to background along a clear depth axis.

setups.label: Scale Contrast Depth
setups.snippet: A large, close foreground subject is set against a much smaller, distant background element, using scale contrast to exaggerate the sense of spatial depth.

setups.label: Overlapping Silhouette Planes
setups.snippet: Successive silhouetted planes overlap from foreground to background, each rendered as a darker or lighter tonal layer to stack visible depth in the frame.

setups.label: Color Temperature Depth Falloff
setups.snippet: Color temperature shifts subtly cooler with each receding plane of the frame, using temperature falloff rather than focus alone to communicate distance.

setups.label: Doorway Frame
setups.snippet: The subject is composed within an open doorway, its rectangular architecture forming a natural frame-within-a-frame that isolates and centers the action beyond it.

setups.label: Window Frame
setups.snippet: A window frame divides the composition, containing the subject within its panes and using the glass edge as a graphic border inside the wider shot.

setups.label: Mirror Frame
setups.snippet: The subject is framed within a mirror's edge, the reflective boundary acting as a secondary frame nested inside the primary composition.

setups.label: Screen Frame
setups.snippet: A television, monitor, or phone screen within the shot contains a secondary image, creating a frame-within-a-frame that layers two visual planes at once.

setups.label: Blinds Frame
setups.snippet: Venetian blinds or slatted shutters cut horizontal bands across the frame, fragmenting the subject into a rhythmic frame-within-a-frame pattern of light and shadow.

setups.label: Arch Frame
setups.snippet: An architectural archway curves around the edges of the composition, its rounded silhouette forming a natural vignette that frames the subject beyond.

setups.label: Vehicle Glass Frame
setups.snippet: The subject is viewed through a car or train window, the glass edge and interior framing elements nesting the scene inside a secondary, moving frame.

setups.label: Crowd Gap Frame
setups.snippet: A narrow gap between figures in a foreground crowd frames the subject beyond, using bodies rather than architecture to create the inner border.

setups.label: Stairwell Frame
setups.snippet: The geometric lines of a stairwell or bannister enclose the subject, its angular negative space forming a graphic secondary frame.

setups.label: Foliage Frame
setups.snippet: Overhanging branches or foreground foliage arch around the edges of the composition, framing the subject with an organic, natural border.

setups.label: Tunnel Frame
setups.snippet: A tunnel, underpass, or corridor frames the subject in silhouette against the bright opening beyond, the dark architecture forming a bold enclosing border.

setups.label: Scaffolding Frame
setups.snippet: Industrial scaffolding or structural beams crisscross the foreground, their geometric grid forming an incidental frame-within-a-frame around the subject.

setups.label: Photoreal Skin Texture
setups.snippet: Skin is rendered with photoreal texture — visible pores, fine lines, and natural sheen — avoiding any airbrushed or artificially smoothed surface.

setups.label: Natural Imperfections
setups.snippet: The subject carries natural imperfections — asymmetry, stray hairs, minor blemishes — left untouched to preserve an authentic, unidealized human presence.

setups.label: Practical Light Realism
setups.snippet: Lighting is motivated entirely by visible practical sources within the scene, with no invisible key light breaking the illusion of a real, lived-in space.

setups.label: Handheld Authenticity
setups.snippet: A subtly handheld camera introduces the small imperfect drift of a real operator, lending the shot an unrehearsed, observational authenticity.

setups.label: Weather-Worn Surfaces
setups.snippet: Surfaces throughout the frame show real weathering — peeling paint, rust streaks, water stains — grounding the environment in tangible physical history.

setups.label: Documentary Grade
setups.snippet: The color grade stays naturalistic and restrained, avoiding stylized saturation or contrast pushes in favor of an accurate, true-to-life documentary tonality.

setups.label: Unretouched Candid Realism
setups.snippet: The moment reads as unretouched and candid, with natural expressions and body language captured rather than posed or directed.

setups.label: Environmental Wear Detail
setups.snippet: Set dressing and props show accumulated real-world wear — scuffed floors, worn handles, faded signage — that sells lived-in environmental history.

setups.label: Fabric & Material Realism
setups.snippet: Clothing and materials are rendered with true fabric behavior — natural drape, creasing, and texture — rather than an artificially crisp or synthetic surface.

setups.label: Naturalistic Color Science
setups.snippet: Color science favors accurate, naturalistic skin and environmental tones over stylized grading, keeping the palette grounded and believable.

setups.label: Imperfect Focus Realism
setups.snippet: Focus carries the small imperfections of a real camera operator — a slight softness or drift — rather than a mathematically perfect lock.

setups.label: Real-World Grime & Dust
setups.snippet: Fine dust, grime, and airborne particulate are visible catching the light, adding the tactile imperfection of a genuinely inhabited physical space.

setups.label: Oner (Continuous Take)
setups.snippet: The entire scene unfolds in a single unbroken continuous take, the camera moving fluidly between beats without a cut to sustain unbroken spatial and temporal continuity.

setups.label: Whip-Pan Transition
setups.snippet: A fast whip pan blurs the frame into motion streaks before snapping to a new subject, using the blur itself as an in-camera scene transition.

setups.label: Push-In Reveal
setups.snippet: The camera pushes slowly and steadily toward the subject, tightening the frame over time to build intensity and reveal emotional detail.

setups.label: Pull-Back Reveal
setups.snippet: The camera pulls back from a tight opening frame to reveal the wider surrounding context, recontextualizing the subject within its environment.

setups.label: Orbit Move
setups.snippet: The camera orbits smoothly around the subject in a continuous arc, revealing the full three-dimensional space surrounding them within one shot.

setups.label: Crash Zoom
setups.snippet: A sudden, aggressive crash zoom snaps the frame from wide to tight in an instant, punctuating the moment with jarring emphasis.

setups.label: Dolly Counter-Move
setups.snippet: The camera dollies in one direction while the subject moves in the opposite direction, holding the frame steady through counter-motion.

setups.label: Top-Down God Shot
setups.snippet: A direct overhead top-down angle looks straight down on the scene, flattening depth into a graphic, god's-eye composition.

setups.label: Low-Mode Gimbal Chase
setups.snippet: The camera rides low to the ground in gimbal-stabilized pursuit, chasing the subject at near ankle height for an urgent, immersive tracking perspective.

setups.label: 360 Spin Reveal
setups.snippet: The camera completes a full 360-degree spin around the subject in one continuous motion, ending back where it began to reveal the entire surrounding space.

setups.label: Vertical Rise Reveal
setups.snippet: The camera rises vertically from a low starting point, revealing scale and scope as it climbs above the subject within a single continuous move.

setups.label: Long-Lens Compression Walk
setups.snippet: A long lens follows the subject's walk from a distance, compressing the background into the frame and keeping the subject visually pinned against it throughout the move.

setups.label: First-Person POV Shot
setups.snippet: The camera adopts the subject's first-person point of view, moving as their eyes would move through the space for an immersive subjective perspective.

setups.label: Over-the-Shoulder Follow
setups.snippet: The camera follows tight behind the subject's shoulder, keeping their point of view and immediate surroundings visible as they move through the space.

setups.label: Drone Flythrough Reveal
setups.snippet: A drone flies continuously through the environment, threading between obstacles before rising or pulling back to reveal the full scale of the location.

setups.label: Static Hold Reveal
setups.snippet: The camera holds perfectly static while the action within the frame reveals new information over time, letting composition rather than camera movement drive the reveal.

setups.label: Locked-Off Tripod
setups.snippet: The camera is locked off on a tripod, perfectly static and stable, letting the action within the frame carry all the movement.

setups.label: Handheld Urgency
setups.snippet: A handheld camera introduces a raw, unstable urgency, its small shakes and reframes lending immediacy and visceral energy to the moment.

setups.label: Steadicam Glide
setups.snippet: A stabilized rig glides smoothly through the space, floating the camera at a consistent height with none of the jitter of handheld operation.

setups.label: Crane Sweep
setups.snippet: A crane arm sweeps the camera through a broad vertical and lateral arc, opening up scale and grandeur as it rises above the scene.

setups.label: Drone Descent
setups.snippet: A drone descends smoothly from a high aerial vantage down toward the subject, collapsing scale from landscape to human-level detail in one continuous move.

setups.label: Body-Mounted Rig
setups.snippet: A body-mounted rig keeps the camera fixed relative to the subject's torso, isolating their face against a swirling, disorienting moving background.

setups.label: Probe Lens Pass-Through
setups.snippet: An ultra-wide probe lens pushes through tight gaps and small apertures in the environment, threading the camera where a normal lens body could never fit.

setups.label: High-Speed Slow-Mo
setups.snippet: Footage is captured at a high frame rate and played back in slow motion, stretching a brief instant into fluid, hyper-detailed extended time.

setups.label: Dolly Track Push
setups.snippet: The camera rides smoothly along a dolly track, pushing or pulling with mechanical precision and none of the drift of a handheld or gimbal move.

setups.label: Gimbal Walk-and-Talk
setups.snippet: A gimbal-stabilized camera follows the subject at walking pace, keeping the frame smooth and level while moving through the environment alongside them.

setups.label: Vehicle-Mounted Rig
setups.snippet: The camera is rigidly mounted to a moving vehicle, holding a fixed relationship to it while the surrounding world streams past in the background.

setups.label: Underwater Housing Rig
setups.snippet: The camera operates inside a submersible housing, moving with the soft resistance and drift of water to capture the scene from beneath the surface.

setups.label: Jib Arm Rise
setups.snippet: A jib arm lifts the camera smoothly upward and over the scene, transitioning from an eye-level frame to an elevated vantage in one fluid arc.

setups.label: Motion-Control Repeat Pass
setups.snippet: A motion-controlled rig repeats an identical, mechanically precise camera path, allowing multiple passes to be composited into a single seamless move.

setups.label: Shoulder-Mount Run-and-Gun
setups.snippet: The camera rides on the operator's shoulder in fast, reactive run-and-gun style, chasing the action with immediate, unplanned energy.

setups.label: 14mm Ultra-Wide
setups.snippet: Shot on an ultra-wide 14mm perspective with pronounced edge distortion, expansive field of view, and dramatic exaggerated depth between near and far elements.

setups.label: 24mm Wide
setups.snippet: Shot on a 24mm wide-angle perspective with a broad field of view and a natural sense of environmental context surrounding the subject.

setups.label: 35mm Standard-Wide
setups.snippet: Shot on a 35mm perspective that balances environmental context with subject presence, a versatile everyday field of view with minimal distortion.

setups.label: 50mm Normal
setups.snippet: Shot on a 50mm normal perspective closely matching natural human vision, rendering the scene with neutral, undistorted proportion.

setups.label: 85mm Portrait
setups.snippet: Shot on an 85mm portrait perspective with flattering facial compression, a pleasingly shallow depth of field, and creamy background separation.

setups.label: 135mm Telephoto
setups.snippet: Shot on a 135mm telephoto perspective with strong background compression, a narrow field of view, and a tightly isolated, intimate framing of the subject.

setups.label: Anamorphic Flare & Bokeh
setups.snippet: Shot with anamorphic characteristics — horizontal streaking blue flares off practical lights, oval-shaped bokeh, and a wider aspect ratio with subtly compressed edges.

setups.label: Vintage Glass Softness
setups.snippet: Shot through vintage-character glass with softened corner sharpness, gentle veiling flare, and a warm, slightly imperfect optical rendering.

setups.label: Macro Lens Detail
setups.snippet: Shot with true macro magnification, resolving fine surface texture at extreme close range with a razor-thin plane of focus.

setups.label: Tilt-Shift Miniature
setups.snippet: Shot with a tilt-shift perspective that skews the focal plane, creating a shallow band of sharp focus that renders the scene with a miniature, toy-like quality.

setups.label: Fisheye Distortion
setups.snippet: Shot through a fisheye perspective with extreme barrel distortion, a circular bulging field of view, and heavily curved straight lines.

setups.label: Zoom Compression
setups.snippet: Shot at the long end of a zoom, compressing spatial depth so foreground and background elements appear pressed closer together than they truly are.

setups.label: Rembrandt Lighting
setups.snippet: Classic Rembrandt lighting places the key light at a 45-degree angle above the subject, casting a small triangular patch of light on the shadowed cheek.

setups.label: Butterfly Lighting
setups.snippet: Butterfly lighting places the key light directly above and in front of the subject's face, casting a small symmetrical shadow beneath the nose.

setups.label: Split Lighting
setups.snippet: Split lighting places the key light directly to the side, dividing the face into one fully lit half and one fully shadowed half.

setups.label: Rim Lighting
setups.snippet: A rim light traces a bright edge of separation around the subject's silhouette, distinguishing them crisply from a darker background.

setups.label: Silhouette Lighting
setups.snippet: The subject is lit entirely from behind, rendering their form as a pure dark silhouette against a bright background with no visible frontal detail.

setups.label: Golden Hour
setups.snippet: Warm, low-angle golden-hour sunlight bathes the scene in a soft amber glow, casting long shadows and gently flattering warm tones.

setups.label: Blue Hour
setups.snippet: Cool, even blue-hour twilight fills the scene with a soft desaturated ambient glow, balanced between the last daylight and emerging artificial light.

setups.label: Sodium Vapor Night
setups.snippet: Sodium-vapor streetlights cast a warm amber-orange glow across the night scene, pooling light in isolated patches against deep surrounding shadow.

setups.label: Neon Practicals
setups.snippet: Colored neon practicals within the frame wash the scene in saturated pink, cyan, and magenta light, their glow reflecting off wet or glossy surfaces.

setups.label: Firelight
setups.snippet: Flickering firelight casts a warm, unstable orange glow that dances across the subject's face, its intensity and shadow shifting moment to moment.

setups.label: Moonlight
setups.snippet: Cool, low-intensity moonlight bathes the scene in a soft blue-silver glow, casting faint long shadows across a dim nocturnal landscape.

setups.label: Overcast Soft Light
setups.snippet: Soft, shadowless overcast daylight wraps evenly around the subject, diffused by a full sky of cloud cover into gentle, flattering illumination.

setups.label: Hard Noon Sun
setups.snippet: Hard, high-angle noon sunlight casts short, dense shadows and harsh contrast directly down onto the scene, with minimal fill in the shadow areas.

setups.label: Strobe Lighting
setups.snippet: A single hard strobe freezes the moment with a burst of intense, directional light, its sharp-edged shadow falling crisply behind the subject.

setups.label: Candlelight
setups.snippet: Warm, low-intensity candlelight flickers softly across the scene, its narrow throw pooling light close to the subject and dropping quickly into shadow.

setups.label: Window Light
setups.snippet: Soft, directional window light spills in from one side of the frame, wrapping gently around the subject with a natural, motivated falloff into shadow.

setups.label: Tension
setups.snippet: Tension is built through tight, restrictive framing, cool desaturated tones, and hard shadow edges that compress the space around the subject.

setups.label: Dread
setups.snippet: Dread is conveyed through near-total darkness at the frame edges, a sickly low-saturation color cast, and unsettling negative space that suggests an unseen threat.

setups.label: Wonder
setups.snippet: Wonder is conveyed through soft upward light, a wide open frame, and a gently glowing, slightly overexposed palette that lifts the eye skyward.

setups.label: Melancholy
setups.snippet: Melancholy is conveyed through muted, desaturated color, soft overcast light, and a slow, still frame heavy with quiet, unresolved stillness.

setups.label: Euphoria
setups.snippet: Euphoria is conveyed through saturated warm color, bright blown-out highlights, and a dynamic, slightly overexposed glow that radiates unrestrained energy.

setups.label: Isolation
setups.snippet: Isolation is conveyed through a small subject set against a vast, empty negative space, with cool, flat light removing any sense of warmth or company.

setups.label: Chaos
setups.snippet: Chaos is conveyed through fragmented, off-kilter framing, clashing hard light sources, and a frenetic sense of visual disorder across the frame.

setups.label: Serenity
setups.snippet: Serenity is conveyed through calm, balanced symmetry, soft even light, and a cool, quiet palette with minimal contrast or visual noise.

setups.label: Nostalgia
setups.snippet: Nostalgia is conveyed through a warm, slightly faded color grade, soft highlight bloom, and gentle grain that evokes the texture of a remembered past.

setups.label: Paranoia
setups.snippet: Paranoia is conveyed through skewed, off-balance framing, deep pockets of shadow at the frame's edge, and a restless, watchful sense of unseen observation.

setups.label: Triumph
setups.snippet: Triumph is conveyed through a low heroic angle, warm rim-lit backlighting, and a wide, expansive frame that elevates the subject above their surroundings.

setups.label: Intimacy
setups.snippet: Intimacy is conveyed through close, tight framing, soft warm low-key light, and shallow depth of field that shuts out the wider world.

setups.label: Alienation
setups.snippet: Alienation is conveyed through cold symmetrical framing, harsh sterile light, and a wide gap of empty space isolating the subject within it.

setups.label: Awe
setups.snippet: Awe is conveyed through a small human figure dwarfed by vast scale, dramatic raking light, and an expansive frame that emphasizes overwhelming grandeur.

setups.label: Grief
setups.snippet: Grief is conveyed through desaturated, heavy shadow, a still and static frame, and low, somber light that settles without movement across the scene.

setups.label: Anticipation
setups.snippet: Anticipation is conveyed through a partially withheld frame, a tight edge of shadow at the composition's border, and a held, charged stillness before motion.
